job.title: Truck Driver
job.description:
Roles and Responsibilities:
Within this role you will be required to preform a range of general butchery tasks including but not limited to:
  • Collect the truck from the Sydney depot early in the morning
  • Load meat products onto the truck and ensure all deliveries are prepared for dispatch
  • Drive a manual MR truck from Sydney to Newcastle, following the designated delivery route
  • Deliver meat products to multiple butcher shops, with delivery addresses provided
  • Manually unload meat products at each delivery location
  • Undertake repetitive manual handling and heavy lifting, with individual items weighing approximately 50–60 kg
  • Ensure deliveries are completed safely, accurately and on schedule
  • Maintain a professional and courteous approach when interacting with customers.
Work Schedule and Hours
Monday – Sydney to Newcastle
  • Approximately 4:00 am: Collect the truck and prepare for loading
  • Complete multiple deliveries to butcher shops throughout the route
  • Overnight stay in Newcastle, with accommodation provided and paid for by the employer
Tuesday – Newcastle to Sydney
  • Complete the return run to Sydney following the Monday overnight stay.
Thursday – Newcastle Delivery Run
  • Complete a shorter delivery run within a single day.
  • The run may involve approximately 12 hours of driving and associated delivery duties.
Additional Information:
The position requires availability for three days per week, with the specific roster and delivery arrangements confirmed prior to commencement.
Essential Requirements
  • Current MR driver's licence
  • Experience driving a manual transmission truck
  • Previous delivery driving experience preferred
  • Physically fit and capable of undertaking frequent manual handling and lifting of heavy meat products (approximately 50–60 kg)
  • Temporary assignment to cover an employee's period of leave
  • Immediate or short-notice availability preferred.
